name: Glance
description: Glance brand: Poppins, purple gradient #A049D0 to #5A34F5, navy #1A1A2E, secondaries #CCABFF / #FFB5A1 / #FF9B99 (glance/brand.json).

roles.cyan: highlight: lavender #CCABFF (the brand's light secondary; reads on dark footage where #5A34F5 would not)
roles.blue: deep anchor: brand primary #5A34F5, the gradient end and the block behind white text

logo.note: Raster crops from the brand book. No vector Glance logo exists on this Mac: ask for the real SVG before a logo card ships.

rules: No new colours outside this palette and #1A1A2E navy; no multiply effect; no colour mix that hurts legibility.
Keep about 6% of the frame as a safe margin, and the logo's clear-space zone free of graphics and text.
